apps.name: Faithful Kids
apps.price: Web: $12.99/mo or $97/yr; annual has a 7-day free trial, monthly has none · iPhone/iPad: $8.99/mo or $79.99/yr (App Store IAP list); annual has a 3-day free trial · Android: $8.99/mo or $79.99/yr; annual has a 3-day free trial
apps.description: Short animated Bible video lessons for kids, each followed by a quiz and a reflection, organized as series from Genesis onward. Includes kid profiles, streaks and levels, and a PIN-protected parent dashboard.
apps.goodFor: Families who want a structured, ad-free daily Bible habit for kids roughly 5 to 15.
apps.worthKnowing: Subscription only after the trial, and prices differ by platform (web vs App Store and Google Play).

apps.name: Bible App for Kids
apps.price: Free (maker says it is always completely free; no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Free interactive Bible story app from YouVersion (Life.Church, in partnership with OneHope). Kids tap through animated stories and activities covering the big stories of the Bible.
apps.goodFor: Young children who want short, playful Bible stories at no cost.
apps.worthKnowing: Best for younger kids; Apple files it in the Ages 6-8 Kids band, so older children may find it simple.

apps.name: Superbook Kids Bible
apps.price: Free (68 free episodes stated in the App Store description; no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Free CBN app with a full Bible, Bible videos, images and games, including 68 full-length episodes of the animated Superbook series.
apps.goodFor: Kids who like longer animated episodes and want free access to Superbook.
apps.worthKnowing: Episodes are long-form cartoons; the app mixes a full Bible text with games, so it is less of a guided lesson path.

apps.name: Minno
apps.price: $10.99/mo or $69.99/yr (App Store); 7-day trial per App Store description
apps.description: Streaming service of Christian kids' shows and Bible videos, formerly called JellyTelly.
apps.goodFor: Families who want a large library of Christian cartoons and shows in one place.
apps.worthKnowing: Subscription required for the full library after the 7-day trial.

apps.name: Yippee TV
apps.price: $7.99/mo or $48.99/yr (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Christian streaming service for kids and families with faith-based shows and movies.
apps.goodFor: Families wanting a lower-priced Christian streaming option for kids.
apps.worthKnowing: Subscription service; it is entertainment-led rather than a structured Bible lesson path.

apps.name: Angel (Angel Studios)
apps.price: Free to download; Angel Guild memberships listed at $12.00 to $20.00 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Streaming app from Angel Studios for its movies and series, including family titles such as The Wayfinders and Tuttle Twins and films like King of Kings.
apps.goodFor: Families looking for faith and values-driven movies and series to watch together.
apps.worthKnowing: Rated 12+ on the App Store and Teen on Google Play; it is a general family and adult catalog, not a kids' app.

apps.name: Great American Pure Flix
apps.price: App Store IAP list shows monthly plans at $7.99, $9.99 and $12.99 and an annual plan at $69.99
apps.description: Faith-based and family-friendly streaming service with movies and series; monthly or annual membership.
apps.goodFor: Parents who want a faith-based movie library for family nights.
apps.worthKnowing: Rated 12+ on the App Store; aimed at families and adults rather than young children.

apps.name: The Chosen
apps.price: Free to stream; no in-app purchases listed on the App Store
apps.description: Official app for The Chosen, the multi-season drama about the life of Jesus. The listing says it is ad-free.
apps.goodFor: Families with older kids and teens watching a dramatized life of Jesus together.
apps.worthKnowing: Rated 12+ on the App Store; it is a drama for older viewers, and it adds invented dialogue and backstory to the Gospel accounts.

apps.name: Adventures in Odyssey Club
apps.price: $9.99/mo, $56.94 per 6 months, or $107.88 per year; 14-day free trial (adventuresinodyssey.com join page)
apps.description: Focus on the Family's membership app for the Adventures in Odyssey audio drama, with access to over 1,000 episodes plus exclusive monthly episodes.
apps.goodFor: Kids 8 to 12 who enjoy story-driven audio drama and screen-free listening.
apps.worthKnowing: Requires a paid membership; the app shows no in-app purchases, so you sign up on the website.

apps.name: Keys for Kids
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed on either store)
apps.description: Daily devotional stories for kids from Keys for Kids Ministries, plus on-demand audio shows, music and Keys for Kids Radio.
apps.goodFor: A free daily devotional habit that kids can listen to or read along with.
apps.worthKnowing: Google Play shows a "Contains ads" label; the App Store rates it 12+, which is unusual for a kids' devotional.

apps.name: Unlocked (Teen Devotional)
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Daily devotional app for teens from Keys for Kids Ministries (published under Children's Bible Hour Inc).
apps.goodFor: Teens who have outgrown kids' devotionals.
apps.worthKnowing: Text-led devotional app built on the Subsplash platform; content is simple compared with study apps.

apps.name: TruPlay
apps.price: $12.99/mo or $69.99/yr (App Store IAP list); 7-day free trial (maker site)
apps.description: Christian game platform for kids with 35+ games, comics and videos built around Bible stories and lessons. The maker says there are no ads, chatrooms or in-app purchases inside the subscription.
apps.goodFor: Kids who want console-style games with a faith message.
apps.worthKnowing: Subscription needed for the full library; it is game-first, so Bible teaching is lighter than in lesson apps.

apps.name: God for Kids
apps.price: Free; optional donations as in-app purchases
apps.description: Scripture Union app with 31 child-centred devotions about God's character, plus music videos, stories and grown-up tips.
apps.goodFor: Preschoolers and children under 10 doing devotions with a parent.
apps.worthKnowing: UK-made; the in-app purchases are donations, and the content set is small (31 devotions).

apps.name: SunScool
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Free Sunday-school-style course for kids with Bible lessons and activities, based on the long-running Bibletime paper course.
apps.goodFor: Families without easy access to Sunday school, or homeschoolers wanting a free Bible course.
apps.worthKnowing: Activity-and-quiz format rather than video; the design is basic.

apps.name: WindowSeat
apps.price: $9.99/mo or $83.90/yr (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Christian audio app for kids with Bible stories, audio dramas (Your Story Hour, Paws & Tales and others), Seeds Kids Worship music and bedtime stories.
apps.goodFor: Screen-free listening in the car or at bedtime.
apps.worthKnowing: Subscription needed for full access; audio only, so no visual Bible lessons.

apps.name: Kids Bible by PRAY.COM
apps.price: Monthly $9.99 or $14.99; yearly $59.99 or $79.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Animated Bible stories with a daily learning path, streaks and badges, guided prayers, bedtime stories and worship music, from Pray.com.
apps.goodFor: Kids 3 to 12 who respond to a daily-path, game-like structure.
apps.worthKnowing: Several overlapping subscription prices are listed ($9.99 to $14.99 monthly, $59.99 to $79.99 yearly); no Google Play version found.

apps.name: Theo
apps.price: $14.99/mo or $59.99/yr (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Bedtime prayer, meditation and Bible story app for families from Familify, with Catholic and Christian content and a filter for non-denominational content.
apps.goodFor: Building a bedtime prayer routine with young children.
apps.worthKnowing: Rooted in Catholic tradition by default (novenas, Rosary for kids); premium is $14.99/mo or $59.99/yr.

apps.name: Abide
apps.price: Premium options from $4.99 to $44.99 listed (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Christian meditation and prayer app with 2,000+ meditations, 365+ bedtime stories including kids' Bible stories, and NIV audio.
apps.goodFor: Parents who also want an app for themselves, with kids' bedtime stories included.
apps.worthKnowing: Mainly an adult app; kids' content is one section of it, and most features are behind premium.

apps.name: Lectio 365
apps.price: Free (listing says completely free)
apps.description: Free daily prayer devotional from 24-7 Prayer, with morning, midday and night prayer times based on Scripture.
apps.goodFor: Parents and teens building a daily prayer rhythm.
apps.worthKnowing: Written for adults and teens; there is no dedicated kids' mode in the listing.

apps.name: Listener Kids: Bible Songs
apps.price: $4.99/mo or $39.99/yr (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Animated Christian music videos for kids, with classic Sunday school songs and Scripture-based songs. Listing says completely ad-free.
apps.goodFor: Toddlers and preschoolers who learn through songs.
apps.worthKnowing: Subscription for the full library; Apple places it in the Ages 0-5 band, so it skews young.

apps.name: Jesus Loves Me (Listener Kids)
apps.price: Full Version $2.99; extras $0.99 each (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Single-song app from Listener Kids with the Jesus Loves Me music video, sing-along karaoke, short Bible verse cartoons and a matching game.
apps.goodFor: Very young children; a small, contained app.
apps.worthKnowing: Small content set; extras are unlocked by small in-app purchases.

apps.name: The Bible Memory App
apps.price: PRO $9.99, PRO Monthly $1.99, Lifetime $19.99, Unlimited Yearly $49.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Scripture memorization app (formerly Scripture Typer) that uses typing and review to help you memorize verses.
apps.goodFor: Older kids, teens and parents memorizing verses together.
apps.worthKnowing: Built for general users, not kids specifically; extra translations and features cost extra.

apps.name: VerseLocker
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Scripture memory app from Scripture Memory Fellowship with five practice modes (listen, fill in, type, first letters, scheduled review) in many translations.
apps.goodFor: Families following a memory program; free on iOS.
apps.worthKnowing: General-audience app; no Google Play listing found under its iOS bundle.

apps.name: Remember Me (Bible Memory)
apps.maker: Remember Me - Bible Memory App. Poimena
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases label on Google Play)
apps.description: Free Bible memory app from Poimena with spaced review and verse games.
apps.goodFor: Free scripture memory practice for older kids and parents.
apps.worthKnowing: General audience; not designed specifically for kids.

apps.name: Scripture Singer
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: App that pairs Bible verses with music to help with memorization.
apps.goodFor: Kids who memorize more easily by singing.
apps.worthKnowing: Made by Advent Herald Academy (Seventh-day Adventist background); small, simple app.

apps.name: Bible Quiz: Scripture & Trivia (DH3 Games)
apps.price: Remove Ads $2.99/$3.99; Premium Mode $2.99/$3.99; listing also cites a $2.99/week subscription
apps.description: Bible trivia game with 100 levels of questions from both Testaments, for kids, teens and adults.
apps.goodFor: Quick trivia rounds for mixed ages.
apps.worthKnowing: The App Store description lists an auto-renewing subscription at $2.99 per week; Google Play shows a "Contains ads" label.

apps.name: Bible Trivia Quiz (Bible Resources)
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Ad-free offline Bible trivia app that shows the related verse after each answer.
apps.goodFor: A free, ad-free trivia option for older kids.
apps.worthKnowing: Simple design; the iOS version was last updated in January 2025.

apps.name: Heroes: The Bible Trivia Game
apps.maker: General Conference Corporation of Seventh-day Adventist
apps.price: Free (listing says free and ad-free)
apps.description: Free, ad-free Bible trivia game where correct answers unlock Bible heroes and power-ups.
apps.goodFor: Kids and families who like trivia with game rewards.
apps.worthKnowing: Published by the General Conference of Seventh-day Adventists (Hope Software Services on Google Play).

apps.name: Bible Coloring Book for Kids
apps.price: Free (listing says truly free; no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Bible coloring pages, memory games and jigsaw puzzles for young children.
apps.goodFor: Preschoolers who like coloring.
apps.worthKnowing: Light on teaching; iOS only in our check (no matching Google Play listing found).

apps.name: Godly Kids: Bible Game
apps.price: Monthly $7.99; yearly $29.99 to $69.99; lifetime $19.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Bible adventure game where kids explore Bible story islands, read stories, unlock characters and build a community, with audio and ministry videos.
apps.goodFor: Kids 6 to 8 who like building and exploration games.
apps.worthKnowing: Many overlapping subscription offers are listed ($7.99/mo, $29.99 to $69.99/yr, $19.99 lifetime).

apps.name: Noah's Ark: Kids Bible Game
apps.price: Unlock all content $1.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Toddler game built around the story of Noah's Ark, from Heaven Born Studios.
apps.goodFor: Toddlers and preschoolers.
apps.worthKnowing: Covers one story only; a $1.99 unlock opens all content on iOS.

apps.name: Bible Kids (BCC Media)
apps.price: Free (listing says free, unlimited, ad-free)
apps.description: Free, ad-free app with animated series such as Bible Heroes of Faith and Bible Stories with Simon & Sarah.
apps.goodFor: A free video option for younger kids.
apps.worthKnowing: Made by BCC Media (Brunstad Christian Church media arm); the listing does not describe the theology behind the content.

apps.name: I Read: The Bible App for Kids
apps.price: Unlocks at $1.99, $4.99 and $9.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Reading app with 98 short Bible stories (48 Old Testament, 50 New Testament), each followed by comprehension questions with a star score. Works offline.
apps.goodFor: Kids who are learning to read independently.
apps.worthKnowing: Text-first; parts are paid unlocks.

apps.name: Bible Stories for the Young
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Storytelling-style Bible videos for children from Tangent Media Network, with new videos added over time.
apps.goodFor: Simple, free storytelling videos.
apps.worthKnowing: iOS only in our check; no Google Play listing found.

apps.name: Bible for Kids Bedtime Stories
apps.price: Full access $4.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Offline audiobook of major Bible stories narrated with calm background music, aimed at bedtime.
apps.goodFor: Toddlers and preschoolers winding down at night.
apps.worthKnowing: Made by an individual developer; full access is a $4.99 purchase; iOS only in our check.

apps.name: Kids Corner Bible Devotions
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Short devotions for elementary-age kids and families with Bible readings, memory verses, reflections and prayers, from ReFrame Ministries.
apps.goodFor: Elementary-age kids starting a daily devotion habit.
apps.worthKnowing: New app (2026), so the content library is still small.

apps.name: VOM Kids
apps.maker: The Voice of the Martyrs, Inc.
apps.price: Free (listing says free and ad-free)
apps.description: Free, ad-free discipleship app from The Voice of the Martyrs with Bible stories, videos and badges, including stories of Christians who face persecution.
apps.goodFor: Older kids learning about courageous faith worldwide.
apps.worthKnowing: Stories of persecution may need a parent nearby for sensitive children.

apps.name: RightNow Kids
apps.price: Free to eligible families (church subscription required)
apps.description: Companion app with weekly lesson recaps, conversation starters and worship videos for families.
apps.goodFor: Families whose church already uses the God's Kids curriculum.
apps.worthKnowing: Only available to families whose church subscribes to the God's Kids curriculum; not open to the public.

apps.name: RightNow Media
apps.price: Sold to churches; no consumer price listed
apps.description: Church-licensed Christian video library with adult Bible studies and a kids' section (Superbook, The Mr. Phil Show and others).
apps.goodFor: Families whose church provides a RightNow Media subscription.
apps.worthKnowing: Access comes through a church or organization subscription; individuals cannot simply buy it in the app.

apps.name: BibleProject
apps.price: Free (all content listed as 100% free)
apps.description: Free animated videos, podcasts and classes that explain the books and themes of the Bible.
apps.goodFor: Older kids, teens and parents who want to understand how the Bible fits together.
apps.worthKnowing: Made for teens and adults; younger kids may find it too dense.

apps.name: Jesus Film Project
apps.price: Free (all content free to watch)
apps.description: Free library of more than 200 films and series about Jesus, including content for children, in many languages.
apps.goodFor: Families who want free films about Jesus, including in other languages.
apps.worthKnowing: Rated 12+ on the App Store and Teen on Google Play; browse before handing it to a young child.

apps.name: Hallow
apps.price: $9.99/mo or $69.99/yr (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Catholic prayer and meditation app with 10,000+ sessions, including Rosary, Bible stories for sleep, Lectio Divina and seasonal challenges.
apps.goodFor: Catholic parents who also want family prayer and sleep stories.
apps.worthKnowing: Mostly an adult app; premium is $9.99/mo or $69.99/yr.

apps.name: Calm Catholic Kids
apps.price: Collections $17.99 to $24.99 each (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Gentle audio app for Catholic children 5 and under: each story features an animal friend who helps a child work through a big feeling. No video or games.
apps.goodFor: Little ones who need calm, screen-light audio with Catholic themes.
apps.worthKnowing: Content is sold as collections ($17.99 to $24.99 each on iOS) rather than one subscription.

apps.name: Saintlings
apps.price: $5.99/mo or $49.99/yr family plan (App Store)
apps.description: iPad-first storybook app that introduces a Catholic saint each day with a story and simple games. No ads, chat or external links.
apps.goodFor: Young Catholic children learning about saints.
apps.worthKnowing: iOS only in our check; subscription for the full year of saints.

apps.name: Holy Heroes
apps.price: $11.99/mo or $99.99/yr; story unlock $3.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Catholic family app with Glory Stories saint audio dramas, kid-led family prayers and weekly Sunday Mass Prep for kids aged 3 and up.
apps.goodFor: Catholic families preparing kids for Sunday Mass.
apps.worthKnowing: New app (first released Sept 2026); subscription plus optional story unlocks. The App Store seller is an individual (Kenneth Davison) and Google Play lists the developer as Holy Heroes; we could not confirm a link to the app on holyheroes.com.

apps.name: Catholic Bible Storybook
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Illustrated Bible storybook from CatholicBrain covering Creation through the early Church.
apps.goodFor: Young Catholic children reading Bible stories with a parent.
apps.worthKnowing: Not updated since 2023 on either store.

apps.name: Formed
apps.price: $9.99/mo or $99.99/yr (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Catholic streaming platform from the Augustine Institute with films, studies and children's programs; many parishes provide free access.
apps.goodFor: Catholic families whose parish offers a Formed subscription.
apps.worthKnowing: General Catholic library, not a kids' app; individual plans are $9.99/mo or $99.99/yr.

apps.name: Audio Catholic Kids
apps.price: Full library $2.99 (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Audio library for Catholic children with My Bible History, the Baltimore Catechism No. 2, First Communion stories and more.
apps.goodFor: Traditional Catholic families wanting classic catechism audio.
apps.worthKnowing: Last updated June 2023 and iOS only; content is older public-domain-era material.

apps.name: Parent Cue
apps.price: Free on iOS; Google Play listing shows an in-app purchases label
apps.description: Weekly prompts and conversation ideas to help parents build faith and character with kids from preschool to teens, from Orange (The reThink Group).
apps.goodFor: Parents who want simple weekly faith conversation starters.
apps.worthKnowing: Best when your church uses Orange curriculum; the Android version is published under a different developer name (Amazing Life).

apps.name: Focus on the Family App
apps.price: Free (no in-app purchases listed)
apps.description: Focus on the Family's app with its broadcasts, articles and resources on marriage and parenting from a Christian perspective.
apps.goodFor: Parents who want Christian parenting advice on demand.
apps.worthKnowing: Parent-facing content, not a kids' app.

apps.name: Victory by Covenant Eyes
apps.price: Covenant Eyes plan $19.99/mo or $219.99/yr (App Store IAP list)
apps.description: Accountability and blocking app from Covenant Eyes for people who want to stop viewing explicit content, with ally reports and courses.
apps.goodFor: Parents and teens who want a Christian accountability tool.
apps.worthKnowing: Built for individual accountability, not full parental controls; the plan is $19.99/mo or $219.99/yr on iOS.

gone.name: The Jesus Storybook Bible (standalone app)
gone.status: no standalone App Store app found
gone.evidence: No App Store search result for the title or for author Sally Lloyd-Jones (iTunes Search API, 2026-11-17). The book is sold as a $15.99 add-on inside the Olive Tree Bible App instead.

gone.name: JellyTelly
gone.evidence: Minno's Google Play package is still com.jellytelly. A new 'Jelly Telly' App Store app (Oct 31, 2026) is an unrelated business phone app from Jelly What, LLC.

gone.name: Scripture Typer
gone.status: renamed to The Bible Memory App (2018); the name is being reused for a new typing product (July 2026 bulletin)
gone.evidence: Developer bulletin Dec 19, 2018 and July 15, 2026; the App Store bundle id is still com.bgolson.scripturetyper.

gone.name: Seeds Family Worship app
gone.status: no app; the brand is now Seeds Kids Worship and streams on Spotify, Apple Music and others (also inside WindowSeat)
gone.evidence: seedsfamilyworship.com redirects to seedskidsworship.com, which lists streaming services only.

gone.name: Owlegories
gone.status: not found on the US App Store
gone.evidence: No App Store search result for 'owlegories' (iTunes Search API, 2026-11-17); owlegories.com returned HTTP 406 to our request. Not checked on Google Play.

gone.name: Verses - Bible Memory
gone.evidence: Last App Store update 2020-03-13; no Google Play listing found.

gone.name: Bible Bee (National Bible Bee)
gone.evidence: biblebee.org links only to a web login at biblebee.app; no App Store result for 'bible bee app'.

gone.name: Slugs & Bugs app
gone.evidence: No App Store result; slugsandbugs.com is live as a music site.
